title: KnowledgeSourceRef
description: One provenance-bound knowledge source. Advisory context, never validation truth: a source is something someone wrote down, an inspector result is something a tool measured. The trust disposition is the intake rubric's verdict and is recorded here so a candidate cannot cite a source nobody vetted.

content_hash.description: Recomputed on every load. Edited content stops matching, which invalidates any bundle that cited it.

origin.description: External collections are DISCOVERY sources, not approved libraries. Anything not on this list has not passed intake and may not be cited by a candidate.

trust_disposition.description: The intake rubric verdict. Only text_review and stricter may influence a candidate; rejected sources are retained with their reason and never copied.
